maddeler.e:
اقتفين (form VIII)
# اِقْتَفَيْنَ (iqtafayna) /iq.ta.faj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اُقْتُفِينَ (uqtufīna) /uq.tu.fiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
# اِقْتَفِينَ (iqtafīna) /iq.ta.fiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَفَى (iqtafā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
